currentContent.description: After a sudden incident, Baki, a Muslim mortician, or ghassal, begins to worry about what will become of his body after death and who will take care of it. Concerned about his loneliness and fears, his friend suggests that getting married might be a solution.
currentContent.title: 1. I, Mortician

data.description: A Turkish mortician in his 30s, Baki is an introverted man content with his isolation from society. However, when he comes up against death at close range, a troubling question strikes him: who would wash his body after he dies? This realization pushes him to venture out into the world, hoping to connect with people and perhaps even find a spouse. Yet, his life-changing decision proves difficult to go through with, leading to a series of awkwardly humorous and sometimes bizarre situations.

episodes.description: After a sudden incident, Baki, a Muslim mortician, or ghassal, begins to worry about what will become of his body after death and who will take care of it. Concerned about his loneliness and fears, his friend suggests that getting married might be a solution.
episodes.title: 1. I, Mortician

episodes.description: Baki continues his search for someone to handle his posthumous washing and finds hope in Nazım, a man who relies on his wife's approval for every decision. Once he secures this approval, Baki eagerly starts teaching Nazım the rituals of washing the deceased. However, an unexpected event takes him by surprise.
episodes.title: 2. Who Dies and Who Lives, Nazım?

episodes.description: With Nazım’s death and Baki performing the late offices, Baki’s search for a successor begins anew. Nazım’s widow refuses to bury him next to his brother due to their past conflicts. Meanwhile, Baki starts preparing halva for Nazım, a task that brings back painful memories.
episodes.title: 3. Sweets and Secrets

episodes.description: Following Nazım's death, Ahmet visits Baki, advising him to find a wife to fill the emptiness of his home. While performing the washing ritual for the mafia boss Taylan, Baki is struck by the contrast between the ostentatious wealth and the hollow mourning. Merdan, the new hearse driver, is initially deceived by the crowd's show of grief but eventually uncovers the true nature of the gathering.
episodes.title: 4. The Dead Deserves No Further Gaze

episodes.description: Baki visits Elif at her workplace for the first time, unintentionally disturbing the employees with his presence. When Elif asks for his assistance with a patient, Baki gets accidentally injured in the process. As he tries to convey his thoughts to Elif, his clumsy wording leads to a misunderstanding between them.
episodes.title: 5. I Wonder Why You Wouldn't Marry Me

episodes.description: Baki visits his friend Ahmet, who fondly reminisces about how he fell in love with his wife, Neslihan. Inspired, Baki tries to replicate Ahmet's experience in his own search for love. However, he unexpectedly runs into Kerime, the bride who once rejected him, leading to an uncomfortable encounter with her mother.
episodes.title: 6. Shuttle, Wallet, Love, and Death

episodes.description: Baki receives the news of his father Haris's release with great trepidation. He travels to the village to take him home, where they meet twenty years later in a strange irony. The tension between them quickly escalates, triggering an argument that brings back painful memories.
episodes.title: 7. The Man Nobody Wants

episodes.description: Seeing Nadir still terrified of washing the dead, Baki suggests he consider a career change. Determined to help, Baki scours his old notebooks for internship opportunities for Nadir and even takes out a loan to support him in starting a new path.
episodes.title: 8. Everyone Left But Me

episodes.description: Baki is involved in a car accident and crosses paths with his rival for Elif's love. When they confront each other at Ahmet's house, Elif is forced to reveal a long-hidden secret that plunges everyone into grief and confusion.
episodes.title: 9. If I'd Not Known, I'd Have Been Free

episodes.description: Uncle Hüseyin and Baki share a deep conversation that transforms Baki's outlook on life. As Baki prepares to meet Elif, a tragic and heartbreaking event binds their fates together.
episodes.title: 10. The Kids and Us

episodes.description: Baki learns that as a single man and a mortician, he has little chance of gaining custody of the orphans. Determined to keep them with him, he decides to change jobs.
episodes.title: 11. Not a 9-Month Father

episodes.description: Learning that there's no one to replace him, Baki is unsure of his next move. When Hande and Merdan find out the new mortician is single, they try to convince Baki to talk to her.
episodes.title: 12. The Fragrant Blend of Rosewater and Zamzam

episodes.description: Baki rents out his late friend’s house to Nihan, but with strict rules. At the municipality’s request, they attend the former muhtar’s death anniversary together.
episodes.title: 13. A Ceremonial Funeral

episodes.description: Baki receives news that time is running out to secure the children’s custody. Without the municipality’s knowledge, Merdan takes Nihan and Baki to a funeral home.
episodes.title: 14. The Most Beautiful of the Zodiac

episodes.description: Baki hesitates to attend his grandmother’s funeral, still wounded by her past rejection. Nihan convinces him to go, but at the funeral, Baki confronts the family that once abandoned him and uncovers a devastating truth about his past.
episodes.title: 15. Dead Grandmothers, Deadly Grandmothers

episodes.description: Baki worries about the adoption of two orphans by prospective parents and secretly plans to meet them. He and Nihan visit his biological mother, stirring mixed feelings. Their shared pain draws them closer with an unexpected question.
episodes.title: 16. Why Am I Called Baki?

episodes.description: Baki’s preparations for a marriage of convenience are cut short by a funeral brought to the mortuary. After what happens there, he leaves with a genuine desire for marriage, not a white one.
episodes.title: 17. Reasons Beyond Love

episodes.description: The mayor holds a meeting with the mortuary staff, urging them to focus on "customer satisfaction." Nihan and Baki are unsure how to handle the Christian couple brought to the mortuary.
episodes.title: 18. A Job for No Smile

episodes.description: While Baki searches for daisies to cheer up Nihan, she witnesses an unusual mourning and a sudden birth that shake her view of life and death.
episodes.title: 19. Born or Dead in the Mortuary

episodes.description: Nihan sinks into deep depression, refusing to leave home for days. One of three bodies brought to the mortuary unexpectedly belongs to someone close. Baki finds out what he must do to get Nihan out of the house.
episodes.title: 20. Not Ugly—Any of Us

episodes.description: While Baki spends a day reflecting on his relationship with social life, Nihan finds herself at an unwanted social event.
episodes.title: 21. Social Veils and Snail's Loneliness

episodes.description: Nihan, in an effort to reconnect with social life, invites Baki to a café. But when the sisters who have just lost their father extend an invitation, neither Nihan nor Baki can refuse, and they find themselves at a house of mourning.
episodes.title: 22. Menemen and the Dinner Table

episodes.description: The new machine installed at the funeral washing room deepens Baki’s already strained relationship with technology.
episodes.title: 23. No Room for Shortcuts

episodes.description: Interviews are held for a new apprentice who will work alongside Nihan. Meanwhile, Nadir is forced to confront a new challenge that comes with being a "gassal."
episodes.title: 24. Born, Not Made: A Gassal

episodes.description: When Baki learns that the residents of a nursing home have not been told about their friend’s passing, he sets out with Nihan and the imam to make it right.
episodes.title: 25. Tell Me About Death. And About Crying, Too.

episodes.description: Hande reminds Baki that it is time to take the next step toward marriage. With the imam and Affan at his side, Baki sets out to choose a ring and prepare for the proposal.
episodes.title: 26. A Single Rock

episodes.description: Baki and Affan set out to find Zamzam water to fulfill the final wish of the deceased brought to the washing room. Meanwhile, a doctor asks Baki to undergo additional tests during his pre-marriage medical check.
episodes.title: 27. A Person Is Only as Much as Their Childhood

episodes.description: Baki’s not-so-warm-hearted father suddenly appears at his door, and he is not alone. After traveling to Eskişehir for a funeral, Baki returns home and confronts his father about his mother’s death.
episodes.title: 28. Why Does a Mother Die?

episodes.description: A prospective foster family is found for the children, but Baki keeps finding fault with every candidate. In the end, he is forced to explain to the social services officers what is really troubling him.
episodes.title: 29. The Last Supper

episodes.description: Unable to find answers from Baki, Nihan goes on a solitary picnic. When Musa learns that Bekir has been released from prison, he sets off after him, driven by a desire for revenge.
episodes.title: 30. Death, Like a Song Stuck on My Tongue

data.spot: When Baki, a mortician, confronts death up close for the first time, he resolves to change something in his solitary life.
data.title: The Late Offices
